availableCommands.name: goal
availableCommands.description: Run until the specified goal is completely finished.

availableCommands.name: compact
availableCommands.description: Compact the conversation now (summarize history to free up the context window).

availableCommands.name: schedule
availableCommands.description: Run an instruction on a recurring schedule or as a one-time timer.

availableCommands.name: browser
availableCommands.description: Invoke a browser agent for web tasks.

availableCommands.name: plan
availableCommands.description: Plan carefully before executing a task.

availableCommands.name: grill-me
availableCommands.description: Interview me to align on a plan.

availableCommands.name: teamwork
availableCommands.description: Invoke a team of agents to autonomously tackle large projects.

availableCommands.name: learn
availableCommands.description: Reflect on recent successes or corrections to capture reusable skills or rules.

availableCommands.name: boost
availableCommands.description: Invoke the Boost multi-agent orchestrator for complex tasks.

availableCommands.name: afk
availableCommands.description: Enter the away posture when the captain invokes /afk, says they are going afk, `state/.afk-contract` or `state/.afk` exists, an incoming message starts with `FM_INJECT_MARK`, or any `state/.subsuper-*` marker is involved. Load it at once in the /afk turn, before any other work, and on the first unmarked message while away to render the return brief.

availableCommands.name: agent-skill-trigger-index
availableCommands.description: Load only when auditing or maintaining the complete agent-only skill trigger index.

availableCommands.name: agy-customizations
availableCommands.description: Comprehensive guide and reference for the Antigravity Customization System. Use to explain how customizations work, their loading priority, discovery mechanisms, and to guide the creation of skills, rules, plugins, hooks, and MCP servers.

availableCommands.name: ahoy
availableCommands.description: Recap visible session events and guide the captain through visibly unanswered decisions when the captain explicitly invokes /ahoy, with a Bearings fallback when /ahoy is the session's first real captain message.

availableCommands.name: antigravity-guide
availableCommands.description: Provides a comprehensive guide, quick reference, and sitemap for Google Antigravity (AGY), including the Antigravity CLI (agy), Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity IDE, Python SDK, slash commands, keybindings, and customizations (skills, rules, MCP, sidecars). Activate this skill when the user asks questions about how to use, configure, or customize Antigravity, AGY, the agy CLI, the Antigravity IDE, or Antigravity 2.0.

availableCommands.name: ask-user-authority
availableCommands.description: Single owner of ask-user finding policy. Load before deciding any ask-user finding.

availableCommands.name: away-quiet-supervision
availableCommands.description: Load whenever /afk or /quiet is invoked, an away or quiet record exists, or a marked away-supervisor message arrives.

availableCommands.name: bearings
availableCommands.description: Generate a "pick up where I left off" fleet digest. Use when the captain invokes /bearings (plain, file, or lavish) or asks for a bearings report, morning brief, status report, catch-up, "where did I leave off", or "what's in the works". Also use on a contributions check wake, when filing work linked to an upstream issue, and on a procevent lavish wake whose source id is the bearings board's.

availableCommands.name: bootstrap-diagnostics
availableCommands.description: Load when the session-start digest's bootstrap or network-checks section, or a standalone bin/fm-bootstrap.sh or bin/fm-startup-network.sh run, prints an actionable diagnostic line - MISSING, MISSING_MANUAL, OUTDATED, PRESENTATION_UNAVAILABLE, BACKEND_INVALID, NEEDS_GH_AUTH, TANGLE, STARTUP_MEMORY_BUDGET, CREW_DISPATCH invalid, FLEET_SYNC, NETWORK_CHECKS, HOME_SUMMARY, BACKLOG_RECONCILE, SECONDMATE_SYNC, SECONDMATE_LIVENESS, SECONDMATE_HANDOFF, NUDGE_SECONDMATES, RECORD_HYGIENE, or FMX - or reports that an interrupted backlog cleanup may have left an endpoint or local copy. A silent bootstrap section, or any other BOOTSTRAP_INFO fact, means no skill load.

availableCommands.name: captain-hold-lifecycle
availableCommands.description: Load before treating an investigation, scout report, structured review, or Lavish review as complete, before ending a visual review that exposed a captain decision, when recording or routing the captain's answer, and on any RECORD DIVERGENCE line the wake drain prints.

availableCommands.name: diagnostic-reasoning
availableCommands.description: Load before scoping a reported bug and before acting on a diagnostic report.

availableCommands.name: firstmate-codexapp
availableCommands.description: Load before creating, reading, steering, archiving, debugging, or reviewing a Codex App visible thread for Firstmate work, and before responding to requests to make Codex App native to Firstmate.

availableCommands.name: firstmate-coding-guidelines
availableCommands.description: Load before editing firstmate's shared, tracked material as defined by AGENTS.md section 1, whether working as firstmate directly or as a crewmate briefed on a firstmate-repo task.

availableCommands.name: firstmate-orca
availableCommands.description: Load when switching to Orca, spawning or supervising Orca-backed work, smoke-testing Orca backend behavior, debugging Orca task state, or reconciling Orca-backed task metadata.

availableCommands.name: firstmate-self-repo
availableCommands.description: Load before dispatching, promoting, relaunching, or delivering any task whose project is the firstmate repository itself, when a firstmate bug or improvement idea surfaces in ordinary use, before granting or revoking upstream publication authority, and before deciding whether any push, pull request, issue, comment, or fork may reach firstmate's own upstream.

availableCommands.name: fmx-respond
availableCommands.description: Relay playbook, loaded only when Relay is enabled. Load on an "x-mention <request_id>", "x-mode-error ...", or "public-followup ..." check wake, on milestone and terminal wakes for a Relay-linked task before posting completion follow-ups, and whenever a promised final public reply must be created, reconciled, or delivered.

availableCommands.name: harness-adapters
availableCommands.description: Load before spawning or recovering a crewmate or secondmate, handling a trust dialog, sending a harness-specific skill invocation, interrupting or exiting an agent, resuming an exited agent, or verifying a new harness adapter.

availableCommands.name: lavish-url
availableCommands.description: Capture a web page URL into an armed, annotatable Lavish review snapshot and route its feedback to the owning project's backlog. Use when the captain invokes /lavish-url <url> [--mobile] or asks to review, annotate, or mark up a live or local website page in Lavish. Also use on a procevent lavish wake whose source id `bin/fm-lavish-url.sh owns` accepts.

availableCommands.name: operational-home-layout
availableCommands.description: Load when locating, interpreting, or changing Firstmate home, config, data, state, project, or generated runtime paths.

availableCommands.name: process-event-sources
availableCommands.description: Load before arming a long-polling source firstmate owns, before registering a deterministic condition->action watch, on any `procevent <adapter> <source-id> <sequence>` check wake, and on any `process-event source stranded` or `process-event source failed to start` check wake.

availableCommands.name: project-management
availableCommands.description: Load before adding, creating, removing, or initializing a project. Cloning or registering a project is add intake and uses the same trigger.

availableCommands.name: quiet
availableCommands.description: Enter quiet supervision mode when the captain invokes /quiet or asks for quiet mode, quiet-while-present, or fewer routine wake turns while they stay in the session. Unlike /afk, ordinary captain chat does not exit it; only an explicit `/quiet off` does.

availableCommands.name: quota-array-dispatch
availableCommands.description: Load when a crew-dispatch rule or default resolves to more than one profile candidate, or a Claude ship or scout is dispatched from a home that declares config/claude-accounts.

availableCommands.name: run-workflow
availableCommands.description: How to write and run a dynamic workflow script with the `run_workflow` tool: a Python script that orchestrates many agents with `agent`, `parallel`, `pipeline`, and `phase`. Use when a task splits into many independent or staged pieces of agent work (fan out over files, modules, bugs, or review angles, then aggregate), or when the user asks for a workflow. Don't use for a single delegated task (use a subagent) or for legacy workflow files (see migrate-workflows).

availableCommands.name: scout-completion
availableCommands.description: Load when a scout reports completion, presents a visual artifact for iteration, or is being considered for promotion to implementation.

availableCommands.name: secondmate-provisioning
availableCommands.description: Load when creating, seeding, validating, launching, recovering, handing backlog to, pushing inherited local material into, or retiring a secondmate home, or when editing data/secondmates.md.

availableCommands.name: session-start-recovery
availableCommands.description: Load when the session-start digest reports unfinished checks, actionable diagnostics, recovery inputs, or output requiring interpretation.

availableCommands.name: ship-landing
availableCommands.description: Load when a ship reports a PR or ready branch, when deciding or monitoring landing, and before task cleanup.

availableCommands.name: stow
availableCommands.description: Sweep the session for uncaptured durable knowledge and unfiled or wrong open work records, and curate startup memory. Use when the captain invokes /stow (e.g. "/stow", "stow what you've learned"), before a session reset or context compaction, or periodically to keep operational memory current.

availableCommands.name: stuck-crewmate-recovery
availableCommands.description: Load when the session-start digest reports an ordinary direct report's endpoint dead or its metadata has no window, after a stale wake, looping pane, repeated confusion, an answered-by-brief question, an unresponsive crewmate, or a failed steer, after observing a defeated Claude or Codex bypass, and when a live crewmate reports its no-mistakes pipeline dead, unreachable, or timed out.

availableCommands.name: swarm
availableCommands.description: (Preview & Quota Heavy) Run a swarm: several agents working in parallel on one task, each in its own conversation, collaborating through a shared message board. Use when the work splits into pieces that can be done at the same time, or when a second pair of eyes should check the first pair's work.

availableCommands.name: updatefirstmate
availableCommands.description: Self-update a running firstmate and its secondmates to the latest from origin, or from a configured self-update source. Use when the captain invokes /updatefirstmate (e.g. "/updatefirstmate", "update firstmate", "pull the latest firstmate").

availableCommands.name: validation-supervision
availableCommands.description: Load when a ship starts or already has an active no-mistakes validation run, including a mid-run requirement change or finding, and before deciding or answering any ask-user finding.
